newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco to tender for 40,000T soft wheat.
newsitem.headline: Morocco to tender for 40,000T soft wheat.

text.p: Morocco will tender on Thursday for 40,000 tonnes optional soft wheat for delivery in first half of November, the Office Interprofessionnel des Cereales et Legumineuses (ONICL) said on Monday.
The closing date for the tender is Thursday at 1530 GMT.
It said a lot of 20,000 tonnes will delivered at the southern port of Agadir. The two other lots of 10,000 tonnes each are for delivery at the northern ports of Tangier and Nador.
